precedents.subject: [FIXTURE] Password reset for customer portal
precedents.answer_snippet: [FIXTURE] Thank you for reaching out. To reset your password, open the customer portal sign-in page and select 'Forgot password'. A reset link is sent to your registered email address and stays valid for a limited time.

precedents.subject: [FIXTURE] Cannot log in after password change
precedents.answer_snippet: [FIXTURE] If the reset email does not arrive, check your spam folder before requesting a new link.

precedents.subject: [FIXTURE] Passwort vergessen
precedents.answer_snippet: [FIXTURE] Bitte nutzen Sie die Funktion 'Passwort vergessen' auf der Anmeldeseite des Kundenportals.

precedents.subject: [FIXTURE] Account locked
precedents.answer_snippet: [FIXTURE] Accounts unlock automatically after 30 minutes. Contact us if the lock persists.

precedents.subject: [FIXTURE] Change registered email
precedents.answer_snippet: [FIXTURE] To change your registered email address, please verify your identity with our support team first.
